name: praxis
description: A lean engineering framework for design, durable work, execution, review, verification, delivery, and continuity.

interface.shortDescription: A lean engineering framework for capable agents
interface.longDescription: Praxis provides independent engineering techniques for design, specifications, decisions, planning and execution, durable work management, debugging, collaboration, review, verification, documentation, worktrees, commits, pull requests, risky operations, and continuity. Each skill defines the boundary, durable state, evidence, and stop conditions for its activity without prescribing a universal lifecycle or the agent's internal reasoning.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the one Praxis skill whose engineering activity is present, and keep ordinary work direct when no skill boundary is needed.
